content:
**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Soybean plants near soil line showing significant stem damage/decay
- Very dark brown to near-black stem discoloration concentrated at the base/soil line
- Dead/collapsed plants — entire plant death visible
- Orange-reddish coloration visible within the dark stem tissue
- Stems appear to have rotted from the base upward

**Comparison with reference:**
The Phytophthora reference shows the same pattern: plant death with wilted leaves remaining attached, brown stem discoloration progressing from the soil line upward. The test image appears to be at a more advanced/late-season stage, but the key diagnostic feature — dark chocolate-brown stem discoloration starting at/below the soil line — is clearly present.

This matches Phytophthora description: *"brown discolored roots and a dark chocolate-brown stem discoloration extending from below the soil line upward several nodes; leaves typically stay attached after plant death."*
